CARTOSAT-2F is a remote sensing satellite, based on ISRO’s Cartosat-2 design and operated by the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO). The CARTOSAT-2 series is based on ISRO’s IRS-2 bus. Each spacecraft has a mass of about 710 kilograms (1,570 lb) and is designed for a five-year service life. The satellites are equipped with reaction wheels, magnetorquers and hydrazine-fuelled reaction control thrusters to provide three-axis stabilization, while a pair of solar arrays generate up to 986 watts of electrical power for the spacecraft.
